serverSettings.env.mode: Proxy operating mode; this panel uses server mode.
serverSettings.env.listen: Address and port where the container accepts AWG connections.
serverSettings.env.remote: Internal MikroTik WireGuard address and port to which the proxy forwards traffic.
serverSettings.env.serverPublicKey: Public key of the MikroTik WireGuard interface. Generating a new key pair will update both the interface key and this variable.
serverSettings.env.clientPublicKey: Legacy single client key or proxy fallback value.
serverSettings.env.clientPublicKeys: Client public-key list; updated from the main client table.
serverSettings.env.randomTrailers: Adds a random trailer to AWG 3.1 handshakes.
serverSettings.env.disableCookies: Disables outbound cookie replies in AWG 3.1.
serverSettings.env.acceptedNotApplied: Accepted for configuration compatibility but not applied by the proxy.
serverSettings.env.stats: Interval for proxy statistics log lines.
